newsitem.title: ANTIGUA: CRICKET-CHANDERPAUL MAY MISS FIRST SRI LANKA TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-CHANDERPAUL MAY MISS FIRST SRI LANKA TEST.

text.p: West Indies may be without top-order batsman Shivnarine Chanderpaul for the first test of the two-match series against Sri Lanka starting on Friday.
The Guyanese left-hander, who was player of the recent home series against India, had two net sessions here but is still complaining about feeling pain in his neck while batting.
West Indies captain Courtney Walsh believes Chanderpaul is a doubtful starter. He missed last Friday's one-day international against Sri Lanka in Port of Spain because of the injury.
"There will be a question mark against him going into tomorrow's match. After net sessions this morning he still had some discomfort," said Walsh.
If Chanderpaul is ruled out, Brian Lara is expected to revert from number four to the number three position, and Barbados' middle order batsman Floyd Reifer will probably win his first test cap.
Curtly Ambrose has the chance to reach a significant landmark in front of his home crowd, needing five more wickets to reach 300 in his 71st test.
Sri Lanka are likely to play left-arm medium fast bowler Sajeeva de Silva alongside either Ravindra Pushpakumara or Dulip Liyanage.
They are to decide on three seamers or two after having a look at the pitch before the start. Just two seamers could mean Kumar Dharmasena supporting fellow off-spinner Muttiah Muralitharan.
The pitch, which will be trimmed before the start of play, is lined with a bit of grass which Walsh believes could help his fast bowlers, unlike pitches here over the last six years.

West Indies (from) - Courtney Walsh (captain), Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Brian Lara, Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Floyd Reifer, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Franklyn Rose, Mervyn Dillon.

Sri Lanka (from) - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Roshan Mahanama, Marvan Atapattu, Hashan Tillekeratne, Aravinda de Silva, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Muttiah Muralitharan, Kumar Dharmasena, Sajeeva de Silva, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Sanjeeva Ranatunga, Dulip Liyanage.
